{{Top}}
[[File:Trooper_assault_TCG_by_Lasahido.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] infantry]]
'''Infantry''' were an essential component in any power's [[Army/Legends|armed forces]]. They often made up the bulk of invasion forces, and were used to defend key installations from the enemy. These [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were commonly on foot, although they could be transported to and from battles by vehicles such as [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]]. The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] would be delivered to battle fields using the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]].<ref name="SWE MTT">{{SWE|technology|mtt|MTT}}</ref>

==Description==
===Equipment===
Infantry were normally equipped with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or some other firearm, and sometimes [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] and a sidearm (normally a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]). Throughout galactic history, numerous armies have equipped their infantry with specially designed combat [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Examples of this included the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

===Anti-infantry tactics===
Vehicles and tactics that were designed to counter infantry were referred to as "anti-infantry." The [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]] (or AT-RT) was an anti-infantry vehicle.<ref name="SWE AT-RT">{{SWE|technology|atrt|AT-RT walker}}</ref> The [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunship]] was an effective craft for destroying infantry and armored units.<ref name="SWE Droid gunship">{{SWE|technology|droid-gunship|droid gunship}}</ref>

==History==
The [[Republic Infantry]] was a division in the army of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that fought battles during the [[Old Republic era]]. [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] were often used as [[Droid/Legends|droid]] infantry for the Separatists during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="SWE Battle droid">{{SWE|technology|battledroid|battle droid}}</ref> while the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] relied on [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to form the bulk of their forces to fight the droid army.
